open_points.subject: import confirmation after an identical re-upload
open_points.text: A16 says another upload, “one of the same bytes included,” replaces the uploaded file and that confirming afterward is refused because the named file is no longer kept; but M11 keeps only the uploaded file, A16 names it by its digest, and A13 accepts the binding when the submission’s input digest equals the pending digest.
open_points.question: Does every accepted re-upload invalidate the pending import confirmation even when the new file has identical bytes and the same digest, and what stored fact or transition distinguishes that replacement?
options: Accept the old confirmation when the re-uploaded file has the same digest and the other bound inputs match.
Invalidate the pending confirmation on every accepted upload, including an identical re-upload.
Give each upload an identity or generation that the confirmation also binds to.
open_points.default_guess: Invalidate the pending confirmation on every accepted upload and require the confirmation step to be shown again.

witness.initial: One owner session holds import file F and a pending confirmation bound to F's digest, picks, names, aliases and Customer values.
events: The owner uploads F again in the same session, with exactly the same bytes.
The owner submits the previously shown confirmation with the same picks and values.
outcomes: Registry accepts the import because the kept file has the bound digest and every bound input still matches A13.
Registry refuses the import because A16 says even a same-byte upload replaced the file named by the confirmation.
witness.observer: The owner sees either a successful import or a refusal requiring a new confirmation step.
